title: Seahorse Stables Place | KEY.co
description_expanded: Very close and convenient from Daphne, AL. User friendly check-in. We had 6 adults, and 3 adult kids and everyone had plenty of space in this 3-level condo. Lower level is great for teenagers to assemble and play foosball or watch tv. Appliances are all new. Plenty of gathering room for meals on the main floor. Although it was too cold for swimming, the pool was right out back. Easy walk to the beach. Very close walk or a short drive to some great restaurants. We will stay here again in the future. Step inside this gem and be greeted by an inviting ambiance filled with coastal themes, an abundance of natural light, and high-end furnishings. The main living area serves as the heart of the home, featuring a plush sofa perfect for cozy movie nights on the flatscreen TV. The adjacent kitchen is a chef's dream, equipped with a gas range, bar seating, ample prep space, and stunning countertops.
